verdict.rationale: The evidence touches data control only indirectly. Self-hosting lets users 'keep full control of your data plane' (signoz-gh-1), and the Drop Logs feature filters out unwanted logs before storage (signoz-docs-53), which limits what is retained. No evidence describes configurable retention periods or deletion of stored data. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings per signal (traces/logs/metrics), explicit deletion/purge controls for stored telemetry, retention controls in SigNoz Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
